name: Hunch
description: Guess what links the words, with as few of them as you can.
hint: Type what links the words · Enter to guess · each miss shows another word
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Work out what links the words.
rules: One word shows at first; every wrong guess shows another, up to five.
The fewer words you need, the better.
Close answers count: "types of trees" is the same as "trees".
One puzzle a day; past days are in the archive.
